note: W2 witnessed re-exec on a Merkle-committed radix trie; membership + non-membership + completeness, real verifier. Scaling rows are MEASURED POINTS, not a rate: units.check_affine refuses an affine fit on them.

controls.name: C_honest
controls.must_fire_because: any honest proof verifies False -- then all rejections below are vacuous

controls.name: C_omit
controls.must_fire_because: a short answer verifies -- omission would be undetectable and completeness would be theatre
controls.can_fail_because: verify_completeness returns True on the short answer

controls.name: C_add
controls.must_fire_because: a fabricated row inside the proven prefix verifies
controls.can_fail_because: verify_completeness returns True on the padded answer

controls.name: C_tamper
controls.can_fail_because: verify_completeness returns True after the one-bit flip

controls.name: C_forged_nonmembership
controls.must_fire_because: a doctored divergence node verifies as absence -- a worker could then deny any row it did not want to return
controls.can_fail_because: forgery_rejected reads 0, or the prover emits an honest absence proof for a present key

controls.name: C_wrong_root
controls.must_fire_because: an honest proof verifies under a foreign root
controls.can_fail_because: the honest proof verifies under the foreign root

controls.name: C_child_order
controls.must_fire_because: reversed child order gives the same digest -- the sort would be decorative and two tries could share a root
controls.can_fail_because: the sorted and reversed digests are equal

controls.name: C_replay
controls.must_fire_because: key A's proof verifies for key B -- proofs would not bind the key they answer
controls.can_fail_because: key A's membership proof verifies for key B

controls.name: C_miss_depth
controls.must_fire_because: the deep arm does not authenticate a longer path than the random arm -- then "hard miss" is a label, not a case

falsifier: Build the same three proofs on MORK pathmap and show the authentication path departs from 1.5-3.3 KB by more than the branching factor explains. Or: exhibit any completeness proof this verifier accepts for an answer set that is not exactly the keys under the queried prefix.
